body: Good building overall. Management is professional and responsive within 48 hours for most issues. Parking situation is genuinely bad though.
Lived here for two years. Quiet neighbours, solid construction, and the Quinpool Road location is extremely convenient.
Decent location near the park, but the building has issues. Heater in my unit broke during winter and it took four days to fix.
The view from the 28th floor is incredible. Location is unbeatable, but the elevators are unreliable.
Very quiet building and well maintained. Expensive, but the location and cleanliness make it worth it.
Clean, quiet, and close to downtown. I had no major issues during my lease.
